The only file to wrap is the one containing the tool implementation. The 'target' parameter determines the recipient of the action and must be recorded verbatim to detect off-scope targets. No abstract parameters are needed as all other parameters are likely fixed or not safety-relevant. The true boundary is the tool itself (capability), not network, credentials, or filesystem, because the tool mediates access to external effects that the agent could not otherwise perform.
